members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity. A stage that survives a data change keeps its place and morphs to its new width.

members.name: label
members.doc: Name of the stage, such as "Added to cart".

members.name: value
members.doc: How many reached this stage. Stages are drawn in the order given.

types.name: FunnelChartProps
types.doc: Use a funnel chart for a fixed sequence of steps, when the question is how many continue from each step to the next.

members.name: label
members.doc: What moves through the funnel, such as "Checkout funnel". Names the chart for assistive technology and heads the readout.

members.name: unit
members.doc: Unit after counts in the header and tooltip, such as "shoppers".

members.name: stageHeight
members.doc: Height of each stage bar in pixels.

members.name: connectorHeight
members.doc: Height of the tapered connector between two stages in pixels.

members.name: hideHeader
members.doc: Hides the headline with the overall conversion.

members.name: activeKey
members.doc: Controlled key of the stage in focus, or null for none. The other stages dim while one is in focus.

members.name: defaultActiveKey
members.doc: Stage in focus on first render when uncontrolled.

members.name: onActiveChange
members.doc: Called when hover, touch or the keyboard moves to another stage, or leaves the chart.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class on the root figure.
